title: The ceramic tide pool
alt: A glazed ceramic tide pool surrounds coral-pink anemones and a small orange crab on a dark rock.
description: Detailed ceramic relief preserves a coherent small animal, continuous rim and contrasting glaze textures.
prompt: An intricately handcrafted ceramic platter shaped like an irregular coastal tide pool, viewed from above. Glazed turquoise water surrounds sculpted coral-pink sea anemones, pale shell forms and one small orange crab on a dark ceramic rock. The crab has one connected body, two claws and attached walking legs arranged naturally. The platter has a clearly visible continuous ivory rim and rests on folded sand-coloured linen. Detailed glaze pooling and clay texture, elegant artisanal photograph, no text.
